semantics.ARCHITECTURAL_PARENT: Logical federation placement only; never implies import/runtime call.
semantics.CONTRACT_FLOW: Producer may emit a typed artifact consumed by the target; authority remains with producer for producer-owned facts.
semantics.RUNTIME_DEPENDENCY: Reserved for verified executable dependency backed by code/deployment/test evidence.
semantics.EVIDENCE_FLOW: Evidence is transferred without transferring domain authority.
